metaDescription: Container cafe units fabricated in container form at our own works. Six sizes, 100 to 400 sq ft, from Rs 2,03,500 ex-GST. Delivered ready to trade in 7-21 days.
opener: A container cafe from SAMAN is a food-service unit built in container form at our Bengaluru and Greater Noida works, then delivered ready to trade. Every unit is newly fabricated on a corrugated MS structural shell rather than converted from a used shipping container, so the counter line, the service opening and the equipment loads are set before the steel is cut. Six sizes are published, from a 100 sq ft single-counter kiosk to a 400 sq ft unit seating 33. The 20x10 ft reference size is Rs 3,70,000 ex-GST.
priceCaption: Base specification price - customisations quoted separately. Ex-factory, ex-GST.
